title: Is there a dense of points in the real plane so that every two points are at a rational distance
exact_target: Can a set be dense throughout the real plane while every pair of its points is a rational distance apart?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 3100066 (AMR-030-0066). CC BY 4.0.
Jozsef Solymosi and Frank de Zeeuw, \emph{On a question of Erdős and Ulam} (2009 revision), Abstract and Section1, definition of rational set and Ulam’s everywhere-dense-plane question, page1.
